Note: the Sewer 200 is also inside the governmental-tagged primary-government budget line 'Transfers In' 40,517 (p16, detail index 11; pass 1 explained that line as different basis); it is one printed amount and is not split. Other other-financing rows: the governmental statement p8 prints two more rows, (50,000) and 63,561, but only in the Total column - the fund columns that carry them (General, Street, Airport, Community Development; printed pp19-25 left halves) are not in the Auditor's PDF/trim, and the Community Center, Medical Center and Keno columns show 0, so no per-fund line can be added. No other-financing rows besides Transfers on pp11-12.
